name: Behringer X-Touch Compact (relative encoders)
notes: Behringer X-Touch Compact in standard MIDI mode with the right-side encoders 9-16 re-configured to RELATIVE mode via the Behringer X-TOUCH Editor (relative2 wire scheme: 1..7 = CW, 121..127 = CCW). Everything else is identical to the 'x-touch-compact' board (absolute top knobs, CC faders, both hardware layers). Split out of the former knob-N-abs/knob-N-rel twin controls: here each side knob is ONE full-size encoder with its integrated push (layer-A notes 8-15). v1 defined no LED-ring feedback for these encoders. A ready-made X-TOUCH Editor preset lives in the repo at mappings/xTouchCompact/xTouchCompactRltv1LayerA.bin. Layer-B knob rotation added 2026-07-27: CC 37-52 (chart-derived from the consistent layer offsets - faders +27, notes +55), top knobs absolute/motorized like layer A, with the existing knob-N-push-b buttons shrunk into them. Layer-B knobs are ALL relative encoders since 2026-08-01 (top 1-8 on CC 37-44 AND side 9-16 on CC 45-52, same relative2 scheme as layer A) - the maintainer's hardware preset configures the full layer B relative; pushes stay the separate knob-N-push-b buttons (notes 55-70). Layer A keeps absolute top knobs 1-8. resendFeedback is ON: in standard mode the board clears a button LED locally on release, so the app must replay its feedback cache periodically (PAM-25).
setupInstructions:
This board expects the right-side encoders 9-16 in RELATIVE mode on BOTH layers - out of the box they send absolute values (use the plain X-Touch Compact board for that).
1. Connect the unit via USB and open the Behringer X-TOUCH Editor (Standard mode).
2. On Layer A, set encoders 9-16 to relative mode (or load the preset xTouchCompactRltv1LayerA.bin from the pam-osc GitHub repo, folder mappings/xTouchCompact).
3. Write the configuration to the device (Dump A).
4. Repeat for Layer B: set ALL encoders 1-16 to relative mode and write it (Dump B).
